description: Expansion and development of fully equipped Autism and Neurodevelopment Unit at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been decided at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21 to give priority for the establishment of a treatment center for children with autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders conforming to international standards, at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children, Colombo, in line with a budget proposal for 2025. The estimated total cost of the said project is Rs. 398.09 million, and the Department of National Planning has granted approval for the implementation of the proposed project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the project through securing the necessary funds for the implementation of the said project within the medium-term budget framework, was approved by the Cabinet.
